svg.title: RabbitMQ
svg.desc: RabbitMQ. A message broker: exchanges route each message into queues, and a consumer holds it until it acknowledges or rejects it. Step 1, Where it sits: Orders publishes, gets a confirm and moves on; RabbitMQ holds the work until each worker takes it. Step 2, Routing by binding: The topic exchange matches each routing key against the bindings: * is one word, # zero or more. Step 3, Push, ack, redeliver: Prefetch 10: email-2 crashes holding 3 unacked; they go back and on to email-1, marked redelivered. Step 4, Poison message and limits: Order 1042 fails every time; past delivery-limit 20 the queue dead-letters it into orders.dead.

g.text: Orders publishes, gets a confirm and moves on; RabbitMQ holds the work until each worker takes it.
The topic exchange matches each routing key against the bindings: * is one word, # zero or more.
Prefetch 10: email-2 crashes holding 3 unacked; they go back and on to email-1, marked redelivered.
Order 1042 fails every time; past delivery-limit 20 the queue dead-letters it into orders.dead.
queue keeps a message until it is acked
consumer gets up to prefetch, then acks
* exactly one word # zero or more words
a publisher confirm waits until 2 of 3 have it
rabbit-3 lost: nothing confirmed is lost
Acked = deleted, no replay: use a stream
Long queues use memory; past the limit
